[[Headache Headquarters|{{Color|Toilet}}]] |first_wave_appearance = 23 |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]700 |defense = {{Defense}}35% |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Average (3) |cash = {{Money|350}} upon death |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Meow}}''' - Upon death, spawns a [[Png Bot3]]. }} ==Description== The '''Png Bot4''' was an enemy that appeared in [[Headache Headquarters]], replacing the [[Breaker4]]. Currently, it only appears when the [[Brain Rot]] modifier is activated in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, replacing every modern [[Breaker4]] variant, or with its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]. It has a high amount of health and defense, though it only has an average speed. Additionally, it spawns a [[Png Bot3]] upon death, which has less health and defense but was faster. ==Appearance== The '''Png Bot4''' is a two-dimensional enemy that had multiple appearances. All of them are various images of cats, some of them being memes and other images of the developer's cats. ==Headache Headquarters Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Headache Headquarters]] is listed instead. *High DPS towers, like the [[Minigunner]], [[Accelerator]], [[Pursuit]] or [[Engineer]] are recommended against this. **The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be useful at boosting their firerate and range respectively. *As this enemy spawns in hordes, towers that can damage multiple enemies at once, such as the [[Shotgunner]] and [[Pyromancer]], can be useful. *As its quite fast, stalling towers like the [[Electroshocker]], [[Brawler]], [[Cryomancer]] or [[Freezer]] can be quite useful. **These towers are especially useful as they can also drop its defense. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1Png1.png|Green variant, DefaultEnemyIconIG.png|'''Png Bot4''' on its bugged [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *This enemy is a reference to [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/subcultures/nextbot-chase-garrys-mod NextBots] that originated from ''Garry's Mod''. These are images that would chase the player, killing them when touched. **All of the images that appear here are cats. Multiple of them are memes, with these being: ***[https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/maxwell-the-cat-spinning-cat Jess], more commonly known as Maxwell the cat. ***[https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/uncanny-cat Canny and Uncanny cat]. ***[https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/sad-banana-cat Sad cat in a banana suit]. ***[https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/happy-happy-happy-cat Happy Cat] jumping up and down. ***[https://www.reddit.com/r/MemeTemplatesOfficial/comments/n9rw4c/fat_cat_withwithout_suit/ Fat cat in a tuxedo]. ***An image of a cat with its mouth open, which is commonly posted alongside a "'':D''" caption on a white background. ***A cropped image of [https://imgur.com/a/AfzIhnS this cat]. **Most other cats are the Tower Defense Simulator developer's cats. ***One of them has been confirmed to belong to StarWarshttps://discord.com/channels/587355301083349002/587355301674614854/1238161449847754894. Additionally, the fifth cat image was uploaded by CapraKinetics, suggesting it likely belongs to CapraKinetics. ==Update History== *'''1 April 2024''' - [[v1.17.2]] **'''Png Bot4''' added. *'''8 April 2024''' - [[v1.18.0]]b **'''Png Bot4''' removed. *'''16 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0]] **'''Png Bot4''' re-added, exclusively to [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''1 April 2025''' - [[v1.58.0|v1.58.1a]] **'''Png Bot4''' now appears in [[Headache Headquarters]] as part of [[April Fools 2025 Event]]. **{{Bug}} '''Png Bot4''' has a broken icon. *'''8 April 2025''' - [[v1.59.0|v1.59.6b]] **'''Png Bot4''' no longer appears in [[Headache Headquarters]], now only appears in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. ==Notes== {{HeadacheHQ|[[Speedy Boss]]|Wave 20|Png Bot4|Wave 23|[[Brute]]|Wave 25}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
